Maya (People Ops): hello Jin W, welcome! Quick security onboarding — please finish Security Onboard course, enroll your device in MDM, enable full-disk encryption, and set up 2FA by Friday. Phishing simulation for new joiners will run this Thursday morning. Link to enroll: https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll and training: https://training.redwood.com/security-onboard. DM IT if you hit any issues.

Jin W: thanks! got my company Mac but FileVault shows "Off". I'm nervous to enable it because of a Time Machine backup I rely on. Any guidance?

Oliver - InfoSec: good question. You can enable FileVault safely if you first archive a current backup and verify it boots. Steps: 1) ensure Time Machine backup is complete 2) enable FileVault in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault 3) save the recovery key to your corporate OneDrive or to your personal escrow. If you use FileVault and later need recovery help, IT can assist if the key is escrowed.

Pri (IT): additional tip: if your backup is on an external drive encrypted with APFS, verify it mounts after encryption. If you prefer, IT can image the machine and preserve your backup state before enabling FileVault. Send your device serial and we'll schedule a quick assist.

Jin W: thanks. also saw mention of a phishing sim. what happens if i click? Will my manager be notified?

Oliver - InfoSec: the sim is educational. If you click the test link you'll get a gentle coaching email and a short remedial module assigned automatically. Managers only see aggregate completion reports, not individual failure emails. No disciplinary action.

Jin W: i'm using my personal phone for 2FA. Will BYOD phone enrollment force installs or access to my photos?

Pri (IT): BYOD phones get a work profile only. We do not access personal photos, messages, or apps. For iPhones we push a VPN cert and a small MDM profile scoped to corporate services. Remote wipe for BYOD removes corporate profiles only. Full device remote wipe is only for company-owned phones after approvals.

Maya (People Ops): if anyone needs a company phone or laptop because of privacy concerns, reply here and we'll arrange a swap. Typical lead time 3-4 business days.

security-bot: Course assigned -> Jin W: "Security Onboard" (course id: 820). Due: 2026-04-12.

Jin W: great, starting the course now. I'll DM my serial for FileVault help if needed. Thanks everyone!"
